nodes.text_en: Which operating function or setting is not behaving as expected?
nodes.text_hi: Kaunsa feature ya setting theek se kaam nahi kar raha?

nodes.text_en: When you press the 'Mode' button on remote, does the mode icon change on both remote and AC panel?
nodes.text_hi: Remote par 'Mode' dabane par kya icon remote aur AC panel dono par badalta hai?

options.label: Yes, icon changes but compressor won't kick in

nodes.text_en: Inverter ACs have a 3-minute compressor protection safety delay before starting cooling. Has 3 minutes passed?
nodes.text_hi: Inverter AC mein cooling shuru hone mein 3 minute ka safety delay hota hai. Kya 3 minute ho chuke hain?

nodes.text_en: Is the AC turning off automatically due to an active Timer or Sleep Mode?
nodes.text_hi: Kya AC kisi purane Timer ya Sleep mode ki vajah se khud band ho raha hai?

options.label: Yes, Timer icon was ON; pressed Cancel
No timer set, still turns off randomly

nodes.text_en: Is the swing flap stuck in one position or making a clicking sound?
nodes.text_hi: Kya swing flap ek jagah atka hua hai ya tik-tik ki awaaz kar raha hai?

nodes.text_en: Is 'Energy Saver' or '6-in-1 AI Convertible' mode limiting cooling capacity to 40% / 60%?
nodes.text_hi: Kya Convertible mode ne capacity ko 40% ya 60% par limit kar rakha hai?

diag_step_motor_swing_broken.probable_cause: Indoor Louver Stepper Motor Broken or Gear Stripped
diag_step_motor_swing_broken.rag_query: LG AC swing flap motor replacement clicking sound
diag_step_motor_swing_broken.technician_note: Inspect stepper motor connector CN-STEP on indoor PCB and replace motor.
